INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.

3. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

4. When practising Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

6. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

7. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

8. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

9. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

11. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Information: Active and passive voice and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
